ana (Product): kicking off a compact Observability MVP scope — want dashboards + two trace hooks + compact cost table + basic error-samples. target pilots only.

rahul (Eng-Platform): OK. keep cardinality low. prefer 0.5% sampling default. pre-aggregated buckets for latency.

marie (Eng-SRE): must include an ops safety gate: synthetic probe + alert dampening. otherwise oncall will get noisy.

chao (Eng-Infra): will run a quick cost delta estimate. if >15% telemetry spend increase, we drop full-trace retention to 3 days.

tess (Solutions): pilots want per-route daily cost and an example error sample with masked user id. will push two customers into the pilot.

sec-bot: Security checklist reminder: any user identifiers must be hashed; per-tenant cost requires explicit opt-in.

ana (Product): proposed acceptance: dashboards (latency heatmap, error-rate by service, per-route cost table), trace hooks (request.start, request.finish), error-samples (sampled traces w/ redacted metadata), rollout to 4 pilots, rollback to legacy metrics on failure. owners: rahul/chao/marie/tess.

rahul (Eng-Platform): I'll sketch the pre-agg schema and a migration note.

chao (Eng-Infra): cost estimate due EOD tomorrow.

marie (Eng-SRE): I'll draft the runbook and synthetic test.

ana (Product): cool — locking scope by EOD unless objections. small ask: minimize new metric names. :white_check_mark:
